info.name: Adyen Get a Link to a Adyen-hosted Onboarding Page

items.docs: Returns a link to an Adyen-hosted onboarding page (HOP) that you can send to your account holder. For more information on how to use HOP, refer to [Hosted onboarding](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/classic/collect-verification-details/hosted-onboarding-page).
